v_introduce.01_welcome.los_santos_runs_o: Los Santos runs on its own rules here. In the next few minutes you will see what you can do, where to find it and how to get started.
v_introduce.01_welcome.read_texts_do_sma: Read the texts, do the small tasks and press {{key:continue}} when the button lights up. Every chapter you finish gives you XP.
v_introduce.01_welcome.this_is_not_gta_o: This is not GTA Online. The jobs, the economy and the activities are our own, built for this server - and the other players live here with you.
v_introduce.02_hud.minimap_shows_where_y: The minimap shows where you are and what is around you. A purple route leads to your own waypoint, a yellow route to your current objective. The bars under it are your health and armor.
v_introduce.02_hud.you_earn_xp_with_jobs:
You earn XP with jobs (races, deathmatches), work jobs and other activities - and with every chapter of this introduction. Your level shows other players how experienced you are.

Short messages at the top of the screen tell you what just happened. Read them.
v_introduce.02_hud.your_cash_your_bank_b: Your cash, your bank balance and your level are hidden most of the time to keep the screen clean.
v_introduce.03_social.chat_is_how_you_ta: The chat is how you talk to everyone on the server. Be friendly - new players are welcome to ask questions.
v_introduce.03_social.enter_sends_your_m: ENTER sends your message. With an empty line it just closes the chat.
v_introduce.03_social.press_or_num_7_to_: Press {{key:social}} (or NUM 7) to open the social panel
v_introduce.03_social.social_panel_holds: The social panel holds your friends, player profiles, crews and private messages. A crew is a group of players with its own tag.
v_introduce.04_phone.backspace_goes_back: BACKSPACE goes back. On the home screen it closes the phone.
v_introduce.04_phone.myveh_call_your_own:
MyVeh - call your own vehicles to you.
Invites - races, deathmatches and other activities other players invite you to.
Contacts - call people of the city who help you: patch you up, get you into an activity, handle your vehicle insurance and more.
Browser - the in-game internet: shops, vehicles, property and your bank.
Settings - wallpaper and phone options.
v_introduce.04_phone.open_myveh_app_arro: Open the MyVeh app (arrow keys, then ENTER)
v_introduce.04_phone.your_phone_is_remot: Your phone is the remote control of your life here: your vehicles, invites from other players, people who can help you and the in-game internet.
v_introduce.05_interaction.arrow_keys_mo: Arrow keys move, ENTER selects, BACKSPACE goes back. {{key:interaction}} closes the menu.
v_introduce.05_interaction.interaction_m: The interaction menu holds what you can do right now: things about you, your vehicle and your surroundings.
v_introduce.05_interaction.some_objects_: Some objects, vehicles and people have a menu of their own. When you look at one, a small prompt appears: press {{key:interact3d}} to open it and pick an option with the number keys 1-9.
v_introduce.06_money.in_game_internet_ha: The in-game internet has websites for shopping, vehicles, property and your bank account. Open it with the Browser app on your phone, or type /browser.
v_introduce.06_money.stores_can_be_robbe: Stores can be robbed. It pays well, but it is a crime, the shopkeeper fights back and other players may come after you.
v_introduce.06_money.your_money_is_kept_: Your money is kept in two places. Cash is what you carry: you pay with it in shops, and it is at risk. The bank keeps the rest safe. Keep only what you need as cash.
v_introduce.07_vehicles.drive_your_own_v: Drive your own vehicle into the Customs workshop to change the paint, wheels, performance parts and the plate. The upgrades stay on the vehicle.
v_introduce.07_vehicles.emergency_vehicl: Emergency vehicles - ambulances, police cars - have emergency lights and a siren. Use them only on duty, when you really respond to an emergency.
v_introduce.07_vehicles.here_is_vehicle_: Here is a vehicle to try things out. It stays where it is - just use the switches.
v_introduce.07_vehicles.hold_3_for_air_h: Hold 3 for the air horn, 2 changes the siren sound.
v_introduce.07_vehicles.hold_and_turn_mo: Hold {{key:radio}} and turn the mouse wheel to change the radio station
v_introduce.07_vehicles.press_to_change_: Press {{key:elsPattern}} to change the flashing pattern
v_introduce.07_vehicles.press_to_switch_: Press {{key:elsLights}} to switch on the emergency lights
Press {{key:elsSiren}} to switch on the siren
v_introduce.07_vehicles.vehicles_you_buy: Vehicles you buy are yours for good. They are saved with their colour, upgrades and plate. Call them with the MyVeh app on your phone and they are delivered to a parking spot near you.
v_introduce.08_work.paramedics_answer_em: Paramedics answer emergency calls, treat patients and take them to hospital. The first time you go on duty as EMS, a separate tutorial teaches you the work.
v_introduce.08_work.work_jobs_pay_and_gi: Work jobs pay and give you a role on the server. Go to a workplace, step into its marker and press {{key:work}} to go on duty: you get the uniform and can take a work vehicle. You can have one work job at a time.
v_introduce.09_activities.arena_war_vehi: Arena War: vehicle battles in the stadium.
v_introduce.09_activities.jobs_are_game_: Jobs are game modes: races and deathmatches played in lobbies. Step into the marker of a job to start one, or accept an invite from another player on your phone.
v_introduce.09_activities.not_everything: Not everything is about money: take a ride on the pier, the cable car up Mount Chiliad, or jump with a parachute from somewhere high.
v_introduce.09_activities.time_trials_ar: Time Trials are routes against the clock. They never stay in one place: every now and then the Time Trial moves somewhere else with a new route. Find its start marker on the map, drive the route and beat the best time.
v_introduce.10_health.injuries_are_reali: Injuries are realistic here. A fall, a crash or a bullet can cause bleeding, broken bones or unconsciousness, and they do not heal by themselves. A blurred, pale screen and a loud heartbeat mean you are hurt.
v_introduce.10_health.paramedics_can_tre: Paramedics can treat you on the spot and take you to a hospital. If your heart stops and nobody saves you, you die and respawn.
v_introduce.11_settings.pause_menu_has_b: The pause menu has the big map, the jobs (races, deathmatches) and the settings. Your settings - graphics, view distance and the rest - are saved to your account.
v_introduce.11_settings.press_to_open_pa: Press {{key:pause}} to open the pause menu
v_introduce.12_rules.one_more_thing_befo: One more thing before you start: the rules. They keep the server fun for everyone. If someone breaks them, type /report and an admin will look at it.
v_introduce.13_finish.city_is_yours_go_w: The city is yours. Go wherever you like and find your own way - have fun, and see you on the streets!
